hook.text: Scrolling your phone before bed is destroying your sleep. Here's the real reason why.
queries: person scrolling phone in bed dark bedroom
blue light phone face dark night closeup
hand holding phone late night bedroom

tips.text: First, blue light blocks melatonin. Your brain thinks it's still daytime. So your body never starts the sleep process. You lie there wide awake for hours.
queries: blue light phone screen face glowing
person eyes wide open dark bedroom
tired person ceiling staring cant sleep

tips.text: Second, scrolling spikes your stress hormones. Every notification triggers a small cortisol release. Your nervous system stays in alert mode all night.
queries: phone notifications popping up screen closeup
fingers scrolling fast social media feed

tips.text: Third, your brain stays overstimulated. Videos, news, and messages keep your mind racing. Try putting your phone in another room one hour before bed.
queries: phone placed on nightstand far away
person reading book before bed peaceful

cta.text: Try this tonight. Put your phone away one hour before bed. Follow for more sleep tips that actually work.
